evaluation.test_policy: No new test predictions until A1 validation diagnosis and bounded expansion decision, all executed validation comparisons and selection.json are persisted; exposed source-test descriptive only

provenance.scope: PHASE A stage 2-3 attention screening, B1 objective fixed, seed 42, sequential A1 diagnosis before conditional A2/A3/A5/A6; no A4 spatial gate, L3 combination, multiseed, boundary head or external data
provenance.precision: preserve CP1 torch.float32 and PyTorch 1.11 TF32 defaults; no AMP
provenance.initialization: one shared ImageNet-initialized state_dict, verified tensor-by-tensor for both baselines
provenance.cp1: artifacts immutable; separate CP2 manifest, evaluator policy and run directories

phase_a.loss: B1 unchanged: source Dice(sigmoid(logits)) + source focal_with_logits(logits)
phase_a.stage_indexing: zero-based source decoder.blocks; concatenated pre-conv channels 176/128, spatial 56/112 at input 224; decoder block 4 unchanged

deferred.A4: NOT RUN — spatial gate deferred until evidence from global gate; no automatic stage-placement/combination matrix

fusion.baseline: attention2(x)+attention1(x); normalized equivalent weights [2/3,1/3,0] at scale 3
fusion.constant_gate: one 3-vector per stage, trainable, initialized from log prior
fusion.input_gate: GAP(input) -> Linear(C,max(8,C//16)) -> ReLU -> Linear(hidden,3) + log_prior; last weights/bias zero; softmax branch axis
fusion.local: DWConv(C,C,3,padding=1,groups=C,bias=True) -> PWConv(C,1,1,bias=True) -> sigmoid; no intermediate activation or normalization
fusion.new_initialization: fork_rng CPU, seed 42+20000+stage for local/capacity; +100 for input-gate; +200 for CBAM; original full state loaded exactly from P before additions

capacity.A5: original P-scSE + DWConv3x3(C,C) -> PWConv(C,h) -> ReLU -> PWConv(h,C); h=round(max(8,C//16)/2), last PW weights/bias zero
capacity.comparison: added active parameters within 5% of A3 added active parameters; actual operations and output RMS reported; no exact functional equivalence claimed

cbam.implementation: avg+max shared channel MLP reduction 16; max+mean spatial concat -> Conv7x7 biasFalse -> BatchNorm(eps1e-5,momentum0.01) -> sigmoid
cbam.caveat: matched upper gain bound 3, not midpoint/distribution; two sigmoid maps midpoint gives 0.75x vs source 1.5x; replacement comparator, not isolated local-branch ablation

expansion_gate.requires: completed real A1, validation only, all integrity and finite-gradient checks passed
expansion_gate.pass_action: Write A1 diagnosis and gate decision BEFORE launching A2/A3/A5/A6, then sequential bounded comparisons without test access
expansion_gate.fail_action: Stop expansion; document remaining candidates not run; keep A0; evaluate only executed model after locked selection
expansion_gate.meaning: feasibility gate, not acceptance/improvement criterion; allows testing whether learned fusion resolves a modest fixed-fusion tradeoff

requires: validation Image Dice strictly higher than A0/B1
selection.ranking: highest overall validation Image Dice; exact ties favor earlier A1,A2,A3,A5,A6; retain A0 if none eligible
selection.latency: reported using same-image shared-GPU sequential inference including cached A0; not a noisy wall-time tuning criterion
selection.test_access: selection persisted before all new test probabilities, no architecture or loss changes from test

analysis.gate_collapse: validation per-image/stage mean, std, normalized entropy, fraction max weight >0.95, subgroups for evaluation only
interventions: A1/A3 drop_local with remaining weights renormalized
A3 fixed_prior_gate instead of input gate
analysis.intervention_policy: descriptive validation only AFTER primary selection, no retraining, not evidence of robust training or causal physiological importance
